csr.description: Base64-encoded PKCS#10 DER certificate signing request.

requestedDuration.description: Requested cert lifetime as a Go duration string accepted by time.ParseDuration, e.g. "720h", "1h30m", "90m", "1.5h". Clamped to the Signer's max-TTL SignConstraints (PR-5).

usages.description: Requested X.509 key/extended-key usages (cert-manager vocabulary: signing, digital signature, content commitment, key encipherment, key agreement, data encipherment, cert sign, crl sign, encipher only, decipher only, any, server auth, client auth, code signing, email protection, s/mime, ipsec end system, ipsec tunnel, ipsec user, timestamping, ocsp signing, microsoft sgc, netscape sgc). The allowed-usage set is enforced by the Signer SignConstraints at issuance (spec FR-005, PR-5), not at the wire layer. ref: cert-manager KeyUsage; RFC 5280 §4.2.1.3.
